en.headline: 11-year-old boy found unconscious at Fanling home later confirmed dead
en.dek: Police received a report from the boy's father at about 6am on Saturday; ambulance officers confirmed death at the scene and investigations continue.
body: An 11-year-old boy was found unconscious in a flat at Yan Chui Garden in Fanling early on Saturday morning and was later confirmed dead, police said.

Officers received a report at about 6am from a man who said his son was unconscious inside a unit at 8 Kat Cheung Street. Ambulance personnel who arrived confirmed that the boy was clearly dead and did not convey him to hospital.
Police cordoned off the scene for investigation. Initial enquiries indicated no suspicious circumstances, according to reports, and the cause of death remains under investigation.
The case is being handled by local police. No further details on the circumstances have been released.

zh.headline: 粉嶺欣翠花園11歲男童家中昏迷 當場證實不治
zh.dek: 今早約6時父親報案，救護員到場證實男童明顯死亡，警方正在調查死因。
body: 粉嶺一名11歲男童今早在家中被發現昏迷，其後證實死亡。
警方接獲一名男子於上午約6時報案，指其兒子在吉祥街8號欣翠花園一個單位內昏迷不醒。救護員到場檢查後，證實男童已明顯死亡，毋須送院。
警方其後封鎖現場調查。據報道，初步調查顯示事件無可疑，但死因仍在調查中。
案件由當地警區跟進，暫時未有更多細節公布。
